_doc: Sign-up / invite-a-friend bonuses by country (owner 2026-11-25: «honest, sorted by country; the list will grow»). Each item: id, go (/go/<id> partner id or null), url (official page when go is null), kind (bank|invest|crypto), v (value for sorting, in the country currency; 0 = unknown), cur, until (YYYY-MM-DD or null), you/friend/need/cash = text per language, src = [title, url] official first, checked = date the terms were last checked. Never invent terms; when a term is unknown say so in the text. Country banner (owner 2026-11-26): «tz» = browser time zones of that country, «feat» = id of the item shown instead of the Telegram Wallet offer card on home + crypto pages for visitors from that country; the item needs «banner» texts per language (t, d, cta, note); it hides itself after «until». «exchanges» (owner 2026-11-26, Crypto-Bubbles-style «Exclusive offers»): crypto exchange welcome rewards shown in the header 🎁 popup, the partner strip under the header and on /bonuses/; «max» only when the exchange's own site states the «up to» figure (else null), «hot» = featured.
